title: sd-docs-lint repository settings
description: Read by `bin/sd-docs-lint` from `.github/sd-docs-lint.json` in the repository it lints. A sibling of `.github/sd-review.json` and `.github/sd-status.json`: it is in git, so a collaborator sees the decision in a diff, and a fresh clone carries it. An absent file means every default. A file that exists and is malformed takes no Jev reading and says why in a note; it never fails the run, because the reading is advisory.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema. Ignored by the reader.

jev_claim_support.description: Opt this repository in to rule 6's second reading, in which a model is asked whether each recorded citation's passage still supports the sentence citing it. Taking it sends the citing sentence and the cited passage, both capped, to a third-party model. Unset or false takes no reading (sd:1304). Only a JSON true opts in. `JEV_SD_DOCS_LINT=0` in the environment still switches the reading off, and no environment variable can switch it on without this key.
